title: Ground-Up Dissection of QCA988x Xtensa HT_COMM 51-Slot RX, Unpack, Pack, and WMI 0x901f TX Tables

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_UNUSED_00
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Unimplemented slot (jumps to default return in RX and Unpack jump tables).

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_POLL_INIT_PARAMS
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Writes `ubnt_poll` target state `+0x04`, `+0x08`, `+0x29`, resets `+0x14`, `+0x19..+0x28`, calls `0x009ae8ec`.

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_POLL_START_STOP
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Updates `ubnt_poll` active state `+0x2c`; calls `0x009b2800` (enable) or `0x009af98c` (disable).

ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Unpacked by `0x009b423c` (3x `uint32_t` + 1x `uint8_t`); packed in `0x009b2f98` for Target->Host notification.

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_TARGET_STATUS_REPORT
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Packed by `ht_comm_pack_msg` (`0x009b31fd`: 1x `uint32_t` at `+0x0c`) and sent via WMI event `0x901f`.

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_POLL_REINIT_RESET
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Header-only reset command (`0x009b13ef`): clears `ubnt_poll` state and calls `0x009ae640` / `0x009afcf4`.

ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Unpacks 6-byte peer MAC + `uint8_t` (`0x009b4151`); resolves `wal_peer` via `0x009b3b2c` and initializes `peer+0x50` (`0x009af644`).

ht_comm_opcode_table.name: HT_COMM_OP_STA_DEL_DISASSOC
ht_comm_opcode_table.target_effects: Unpacks 6-byte peer MAC + `uint8_t` (`0x009b4151`); invokes `0x009b0240` to tear down TDMA peer state.

pillar_a_ground_up_re_and_knob_catalog.evidence: Instruction-level disassembly of all 51 slots (0..50) of ht_comm_rx_dispatch (0x009b1024) and ht_comm_unpack_msg (0x009b3c88), plus ht_comm_pack_msg (0x009b2f98) and ht_comm_tx_send (0x009b43a0).

pillar_b_hyperresearch_and_scholar_react.evidence: Reconciled host-side ubnt_poll_host.ko HT_COMM framing with target-side QCA988x Xtensa 0xaa 0x05 wire protocol and WMI event 0x901f.

pillar_c_karpathy_autoresearch_and_watch.evidence: Purely offline static analysis (`live_devices_touched=False`); maps exact opcodes controlling `g_dbg_max_sw_retry` (Opcode 14) and per-peer TDMA quota weights (Opcode 12).

pillar_d_scientific_pareto_validation.evidence: Proved 100% byte-identity (`sha256` match) of the entire HT_COMM module (`0x009b1024..0x009b4480`) across `WA.v8.7.25` and `XC.v8.7.25`.
